meta.name: Feluda Pherot
meta.description:
Chronicles the adventures of Prodosh Chandra Mitra a Bengali private detective along with his sidekick Topesh and friend Lalmohan Ganguly

Returning Series · First aired 25 Dec 2020 · India · Language: Bengali

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

On your server — Audio: Bengali (from file names)

videos.title: Chhinnomostar Obhishap | E1
videos.overview: On their trip to Hazaribagh, Feluda and his comrades meet Pritin, Mahesh Babu's youngest son. Meanwhile, they learn that a tiger escapes from the Great Majectic Circus.
